'''Aine 16 (March 31)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[998 NE]] - [[Rand]] meets [[Min Farshaw]] for the first time.
*[[998 NE]] - [[Nynaeve]] tracks down the young [[Two Rivers]] folk in [[Baerlon]].
*[[998 NE]] - A [[Myrddraal]] attacks Rand in Baerlon, forcing the party to flee.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Moridin]] summons the [[Forsaken]] for a meeting in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''.
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Mat]]'s party arrives at Rummien's Crossing. Mat and [[Aludra]] discuss using her fireworks as a weapon.
